features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.desc: As an action, you give a creature Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.desc: As an action, you become Invisible until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.desc: You create up to four copies with Invoke Duplicity.
